title: Sum of Multiples
summary: Sum every unique number below limit that is a multiple of at least one of the factors. A factor of 0 is ignored.
hints: Loop over every candidate number from 1 up to (but not including) limit.
A number counts once, even if several factors divide it: stop checking factors as soon as one matches.
Skip a factor of 0 before using it with the remainder operator.

cases.description: limit too small for any multiple
factor 1 sums everything below the limit
limit equal to a multiple is excluded
